# Shopify

> > Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform enabling businesses to build, sell, and grow across online and retail channels with AI-powered tools and global reach.

Shopify provides a comprehensive suite of ecommerce, point-of-sale, and multichannel selling solutions designed for merchants of all sizes—from startups to enterprises. The platform combines website building, inventory management, payments processing, and AI-powered features like Sidekick and Magic to streamline commerce operations.

## Key Topics

- Ecommerce Platform
- Point of Sale (POS)
- Multichannel Selling
- AI Commerce Assistant (Sidekick)
- Website Builder
- Shopify Themes
- Marketing Automation
- Payments Processing
- B2B Commerce
- Global Expansion
- Customer Accounts
- Shop Marketplace
- Checkout Optimization
- Inventory Management
- Merchant Tools

## Getting Started

- [Shopify: The All-in-One Commerce Platform](https://www.shopify.com): Shopify's all-in-one commerce platform for ecommerce, POS, and multichannel selling.
- [Start Your Online Store Today](https://www.shopify.com/start): Quick-start guide to launch an online store with Shopify's setup wizard.
- [Migrate to Shopify and Sell More](https://www.shopify.com/sell): Shopify migration benefits, pricing comparison, and sales growth features.

## Store Building & Design

- [Ecommerce Website Builder](https://www.shopify.com/website/builder): No-code AI-powered website builder with themes and customizable templates.
- [Ecommerce Website Templates](https://themes.shopify.com): Marketplace with 800+ free and premium Shopify themes for online stores.
- [Build Your Online Store](https://www.shopify.com/online): Online store building options: themed or headless commerce architecture.
- [Buy a Domain Name](https://www.shopify.com/domains): Domain registration and management with DNS, SSL, and WHOIS support.

## Selling & Commerce Features

- [Point of Sale (POS) System](https://www.shopify.com/pos): Shopify POS system for retail with inventory, checkout, and payments.
- [Multichannel Sales Channels](https://www.shopify.com/channels): Multichannel selling on Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Facebook, and more.
- [Sell on Shop Marketplace](https://www.shopify.com/shop): Shop marketplace channel for reaching high-intent shoppers with Shop Pay.
- [B2B Commerce Platform](https://www.shopify.com/plus/solutions/b2b-ecommerce): Shopify Plus B2B platform for wholesale and direct-to-consumer integration.
- [Launch Discount Promotions](https://www.shopify.com/discounts): Discount and promotion tools for sales conversion and customer retention.

## AI & Customer Experience

- [Sidekick: AI Commerce Assistant](https://www.shopify.com/sidekick): Sidekick AI assistant for store building, design, and business automation.
- [Shopify Magic & AI Tools](https://www.shopify.com/magic): Suite of AI tools for product images, email, content creation, and automation.
- [Customer Accounts Portal](https://www.shopify.com/customer-accounts): Self-service customer portal for order, subscription, and loyalty management.

## Marketing & Growth

- [Marketing on Shopify](https://www.shopify.com/marketing): Marketing automation, Shop Campaigns, and customer acquisition tools.
- [Marketing Automation Tools](https://www.shopify.com/marketing-automation-tools): Connected marketing tools: messaging, forms, automations, and segmentation.

## Global & Enterprise Solutions

- [Shopify for Enterprise](https://www.shopify.com/enterprise): Enterprise-grade commerce platform with unified POS and B2B/B2C capabilities.
- [Expand Into New Markets](https://www.shopify.com/markets): Multi-market expansion with localization for B2B, D2C, online, and retail.
- [Sell to International Customers](https://www.shopify.com/international): Global expansion with localization, multi-currency, and cross-border selling.
